prompts.stage1: Investigate this real issue against the pinned repository and early discussion. Once you identify a relevant source location and a relevant discussion record, give a concise handoff: reported behavior, file and line, evidence, and unresolved questions. Search further only for a specific remaining uncertainty. Do not edit code.
prompts.stage2: Continue the earlier investigation using the later discussion and your own prior handoff, available in the archive. Produce a concise triage: reported behavior, source evidence with file and line, relevant discussion or disagreement with comment IDs, recommended next check or action, and explicit uncertainty. Stop searching once the evidence suffices. Do not edit code.

protocol: Random arm order; two separate Claude Code sessions per arm, same public issue, staged comments, read-only source tools and own handoff; treatment adds Memex hooks and MCP. Run two tasks first, inspect infrastructure, then continue.
recovery: One tool-free continuation of the same session on a budget-exhausted response; preserve both attempts and treat cumulative token use as unknown when not reconciled.
completion: Both arms must produce valid second-session responses; retain incomplete and failed sessions.
limits: Public historical issues and discussions may be in model training.
Source snapshots can postdate discussion and include later changes.
Compressed read-only triage is not live production work, an executable fix or a measure of deployed task correctness.
AI judges are not human reviewers. Token usage and client list price are not an APIMaster invoice.
